name: Syria
description: A horizontal tricolour of green, white and black, the white stripe bearing three red five-pointed stars in a row.
history: The 'independence flag', laid down in the 1930 constitution of the French-mandate Republic of Syria and first hoisted at Damascus on 11 June 1932. It served as the national flag until the union with Egypt in 1958 and again from the secession of 1961 until the Ba'athist coup of March 1963. Taken up as the banner of the opposition in 2011, it returned to official use de facto with the fall of the Assad government on 8 December 2024 and was made official by the Constitutional Declaration of 13 March 2025.

features.symbolism: green for the Rashidun, white for the Umayyads and black for the Abbasids
